case_number: 2024 INSC 414; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) NO(S). OF 2024)
summary: Illegal arrest under UAPA; grounds of arrest not communicated per Article 22(1); remand order passed without appellant's counsel being present; reliance on Pankaj Bansal v. Union of India; FIR allegedly filed without substance; failure to provide copy of FIR prior to arrest; custody remand challenged based on procedural illegality.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India Art.20, Art.21, Art.22
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeal allowed on grounds of violation of Article 22(1) as the grounds of arrest were not provided.
